title.zh: 删除存储空间的加密规则
title.en: Delete the encryption rule of a bucket

descriptions.zh: 只有Bucket的拥有者及授权的RAM用户才能删除Bucket的加密规则，否则返回403错误。有关Bucket加密的更多信息，请参见[服务器端加密](~~31871~~)。
descriptions.en: Only the bucket owner and Resource Access Management (RAM) users with authorization can delete the encryption rule of a bucket. Otherwise, a 403 fault is returned. For more information about bucket encryption, see [Server-side encryption](~~31871~~).
